display: Surfboard shaper in Ericeira, Portugal. I hand-shape about 150 custom boards a year in a garage workshop and I'm looking into longer-lasting bio-resins.

signals.text: I'm shaping eleven boards right now, and autumn swell season means the orders keep coming.
I want a bio-based resin that holds its colour for three seasons. Every one I've tried turns the colour of weak tea within a year.
I'm tired of reading forum posts about bio-resins where half the comments say it works and half say it delaminates. I want someone who has actually used one on boards for a few seasons.
I need to cut my exposure to resin and solvent fumes in the glassing and laminating stages without cutting output below roughly 100 boards a year.
I'd like help with glassing and laminating, but everyone I know who can glass a board properly already has their own shop.
December lead times are getting tight. A surf school wants six boards by 1 December and I'm not sure I can promise it.
I'd like to find a low-fume way to run my spray booth and glassing bay, or tips from other workshops on ventilation and extraction.
My doctor told me to cut my exposure to resin and isocyanate fumes, and my night cough is probably linked to it. I'm looking for practical ways to keep shaping.
My residency renewal appointment has been rescheduled three times and is now in November. I'm worried about my paperwork lapsing.
I rebuild a 1978 VW Type 2 engine on my workshop bench as a break from foam dust, and I'd enjoy talking to other air-cooled VW people.
I miss having peers to talk shop with. I'm an Australian shaper on my own in a garage in Portugal, and I'd like to compare notes with other shapers.

offers.text: Hand-shaped custom surfboards: shortboards, mid-lengths, fish and guns, with twenty years of shaping behind them.
A fully equipped garage workshop in Ericeira with a planer, dust extraction, a glassing bay and a small spray booth.
Regular supply to local surfers, a surf school, and shops in Peniche and Lagos. I can deliver along the Portuguese coast.
I'd test a bio-resin on real boards in real sun and report honestly on yellowing, cracking and delamination after a full season of use.
I can help a surf school, shop or surfer work out which board shape suits their wave, their level and their budget.
I teach kids to surf at dawn and I'm comfortable with beginners and nervous parents.
I hold a stock of EPS and PU blanks, fibreglass cloth and epoxy and polyester resins, and can advise on materials and repairs.
I can talk through an old air-cooled VW engine rebuild, including carburettors and bench work.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I make plant-based epoxy and flax cloth. Does anyone shape boards who would test a UV-stable batch properly?
catchers.can: I'd lay up a test board or panels, leave them in the sun and surf for a full season, and give detailed, honest feedback on yellowing and bond strength.
catchers.confirm: Is your resin UV-stabilised and able to stay clear for at least three seasons of surf and sun, with test data or real boards behind that?

catchers.hypo: I'm a glasser, freshly out of an apprenticeship, in the Lisbon area and I want to learn from a shaper. Do you need someone to laminate?
catchers.can: I could take on a trusted glasser for laminating and finishing, starting with supervised work on a few boards.
catchers.confirm: Have you glassed surfboards, as opposed to boats or general fibreglass, and can you show me any finished boards?

catchers.hypo: I run a surf school and need eight boards for the new season. Can you build a batch of beginner-friendly boards?
catchers.can: I can quote a batch of mid-lengths or soft-friendly boards and a realistic delivery date. I'd also ask my surf school contact for advice on what works for learners.
catchers.confirm: Do you need the boards delivered at least eight weeks from now?

catchers.hypo: I'm a small shaper in Cornwall and I'm looking for a resin without isocyanates that surfers will actually accept. What do you use?
catchers.can: I can share what I've learned about commercial bio-resins, and my resin supplier is honest about their limits and could point you to what works.
catchers.confirm: Are you shaping and glassing boards yourself, rather than just buying finished boards?

catchers.hypo: I'm an occupational hygienist and I'd like to look at a small board-building workshop's fume extraction and respirator setup.
catchers.can: I could open the workshop for an extraction and respirator review, and share the layout of the glassing bay and spray booth.
catchers.confirm: Do you have hands-on experience with workshops that use fibreglass, epoxy or polyester resins, rather than general industrial settings only?

catchers.hypo: I'm Australian, moving to Portugal next year, and I'm trying to understand how the residency renewal and sole-trader registration actually work.
catchers.can: I can share what I've learned about renewing a Portuguese residency card and registering as a sole trader, and describe the AIMA appointment process.
catchers.confirm: Are you already in Portugal, or about to start the residency process there as a self-employed person?

catchers.hypo: My son is ten and wants his first proper board. Do you shape for kids, and could you help us choose one?
catchers.can: I can shape a grom's board to the child's size and ability, and I have experience coaching young surfers.
catchers.confirm: Is the board for a child under twelve who already surfs or is learning to?

catchers.hypo: I'm an Australian shaper on the Gold Coast and I'd like to talk with another expat about running a small shop abroad.
catchers.can: My old mate on the Gold Coast and I can compare notes, and I can introduce you to him if you want an Australian industry view.
catchers.confirm: Are you a working shaper or glasser who has run, or plans to run, your own workshop?

forbids.text: I won't use a resin that yellows fast, even if it's greener.
I won't hire anyone I don't trust with glassing.
I can't cut output much below about 100 boards a year.
I won't commit to delivery dates I can't meet, so I may decline rush orders.
I'm based in Ericeira, so I can't do work that needs me to travel for long periods.

projects.name: Bio-resin test on real boards
projects.text: I want to test a plant-based epoxy that stays clear for three seasons, built into real surfboards and surfed in real conditions.
roles_needed: surfers willing to ride and report on test boards

projects.name: Glassing and laminating help for the Ericeira workshop
projects.text: I'm looking for a trusted glasser to take on part of the laminating and finishing, to ease my workload during the busy season.

policy.t1: When there's a real lead, I'll share what I've tried with bio-resins and why commercial ones fail for me, my capacity and lead times, and what kind of help I need in the glassing bay.
policy.t2: Once I've confirmed who you are and the fit is strong, I'll share that my doctor has asked me to reduce fume exposure, and that my residency renewal is pending.
policy.never: Medical records and test results, money and income details, and private family matters.
